description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small medieval village props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: wooden barrel, wooden crate, round hay bale, straw training dummy on a wooden post with a burlap sack head, short wooden picket fence section, small wooden bench, wooden flower planter box with red flowers, iron street lamp post, wooden wheelbarrow, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate with empty transparent space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette, front-facing view. Do not draw this house or tree.
